allow-critical.description: Show critical notifications during Do Not Disturb
allow-critical.tooltip: Critical urgency only. Has no effect while notifications are turned off in System Settings, because Cinnamon then shows no banners at all.

dnd-info.description: Hush keeps its own Do Not Disturb state; it never changes the Notifications switch in System Settings. Turning notifications off there counts as Do Not Disturb here as well. Switching Do Not Disturb off in the drawer while a schedule or an automatic trigger holds it overrides that trigger until it ends (for the schedule: until its next start or end).

schedule-enabled.description: Turn on Do Not Disturb on a schedule

schedule-end.tooltip: An end earlier than the start means overnight. Equal times mean all day.

schedule-days.tooltip: A window belongs to the day it starts on: with Weekdays and 22:00 to 07:00, Friday night to Saturday morning is included.

auto-recording.description: While a call or recording is in progress
auto-recording.tooltip: An application is recording from a microphone or capture source (a voice or video call, a screen recording with audio, OBS with a microphone). Level meters such as pavucontrol's are ignored.

auto-inhibitor-apps.description: While a listed application holds a session inhibitor
auto-inhibitor-apps.tooltip: OBS asks the session not to go idle while it records or streams; Hush treats that as recording. Applications that use the older screensaver interface (Chromium, Electron apps such as Discord) are not visible this way.

inhibitor-apps.description: Applications whose inhibitors count as recording
inhibitor-apps.tooltip: The id an application gives the session manager, usually its desktop file name without .desktop. Case does not matter.

muted-info.description: Muted applications never show a banner or play a sound; their notifications are still collected in the drawer unless "Drop" is set. The mute button next to an application's name in the drawer adds it here.

muted-apps.tooltip: Application id as Hush derives it (desktop file name without .desktop, lower case, or the name the app sends). Drop: do not keep its notifications at all.

drawer-direction.tooltip: Automatic: the panel's own side for a vertical panel; for a horizontal panel, the side of the screen the applet sits on.

history-max.tooltip: Counts every state (unread, read, cleared). The oldest cleared ones are pruned first.

ignore-transient.tooltip: Transient notifications (volume changes, progress) still show a banner but are not listed in the drawer.

persist-history.description: Keep the list across logouts and Cinnamon restarts
persist-history.tooltip: Stored as plain text in ~/.local/share/hush/history.json. Turning this off deletes the file.

show-count.description: Show the unread count on the panel

blink-on-new.description: Blink the panel icon while an unread critical notification is waiting

test-info.description: Each button sends one notification through the session bus, exactly as an application would. With Do Not Disturb on they are collected in the drawer instead of shown; the panel count goes up.

test-critical.tooltip: Urgency critical: never expires; shows during Do Not Disturb when allowed.

test-actions.tooltip: A default action plus two buttons; the answer is logged in Looking Glass.

test-markup.tooltip: Bold, italic, underline, an ampersand, a link and an unsupported tag.

test-transient.tooltip: Banner only; not kept when "Do not keep transient notifications" is on.

test-image.tooltip: An icon and a large image.

test-app.tooltip: Hint desktop-entry = cinnamon-settings: grouped under System Settings with its icon.

test-long.tooltip: Five lines of body; checks wrapping and cut-off.

test-updating.tooltip: One resident notification updated in place four times over five seconds.

test-burst.description: Burst of five from three apps
test-burst.tooltip: Grouping and ordering in the drawer.

test-toggle-dnd.tooltip: Same as middle-clicking the panel icon.

test-open-drawer.tooltip: Same as left-clicking the panel icon.

test-clear.tooltip: Dismisses every entry sent from this page (app name "Hush Test", "Mail", "Messenger", "Software Updater", "System Settings") and forgets them.

test-inhibit.description: Hold a test inhibitor for 10 seconds
test-inhibit.tooltip: Takes a session inhibitor under the first id in the list above (as OBS would while recording) and releases it after 10 seconds. Expect the status line to read "On — <app> is running an inhibitor" meanwhile.
